## Source: amazon-inspector (a62148ab04b3109e06da6f1dddfd10481746b4b18218e51f6f99852cea7a1744)
Analysis of ttsflow 0.1.0 on PyPI did not surface any behavior indicating a supply-chain attack against installers. No install-time or import-time network activity, credential or filesystem harvesting, remote code fetch-and-execute, silent-relay, backdoor, or dependency-dropper pattern was identified in the package's shipped contents.

## Source: kam193 (ca06c0d356aef80eb13ae19e8a7e17cacdb0e1d3b1ba0f250387d8b18d110395)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
